mcqs.question: India's first National Household Travel Survey was conducted by which organisation?
options: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
mcqs.explanation: India's first National Household Travel Survey was conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under MoSPI during July 2025–June 2026. CSO and NSSO were organisations merged to form NSO in 2019; MoSPI is the ministry under which NSO functions, not the conducting organisation identified for the survey.
